name: Local Pairwise Conflict Formulation
description: Replaces a global "exact cover" or "maximum diversity" condition with an equivalent pairwise conflict condition ("no two selected items share any parameter"). Models relying on surface phrasing will map this to Maximum Clique or Independent Set and write an unoptimized search that TLEs, failing to recognize the underlying 3D matching structure that allows efficient coordinate-based branching.
